Name: Filled-In Opal Paths
Author: NCTX
Description: A simple Content Patcher mod that uses the layout of stones from Kirtini's Filled In Crystal Path, and the stone design of Opal Paths, to create Filled In Opal Paths. Generic Mod Config Menu compatible to switch between the color options originally available from Opal Paths (Opal and Fire Opal).
